arxiv-2202-07063.title: Cosmic-ray propagation and production of secondary particles in the Galaxy
arxiv-2202-07063.creator: Pedro de la Torre Luque
arxiv-2202-07063.description: Abstract Cosmic rays are nowadays a crucial tool to study the astrophysics of extreme objects in the Universe, the cosmic environmental plasma (both Galactic and extra-galactic), the physics of hadronic interactions or the properties of elementary particles at very high energies and even cosmological problems such as the dark matter puzzle.

arxiv-2207-10497.title: Computing the homology functor on semi-algebraic maps and diagrams Thanks: Basu was partially supported by NSF grants CCF-1910441.
arxiv-2207-10497.creator: Saugata Basu, Negin Karisani
arxiv-2207-10497.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Saugata Basu, Negin Karisani. Developing an algorithm for computing the Betti numbers of semi-algebraic sets with singly exponential complexity has been a holy grail in algorithmic semi-algebraic geometry and only partial results are known. In this paper we consider the more general problem of computing the image under the homology functor of a semi-algebraic map f : X → Y f:X\rightarrow Y between closed and bounded semi-algebraic sets.

arxiv-2309-03906.title: A-Eval: A Benchmark for Cross-Dataset Evaluation of Abdominal Multi-Organ Segmentation
arxiv-2309-03906.creator: Ziyan Huang, Zhongying Deng, Haoyu Wang, Yanzhou Su, Tianbin Li, Hui Sun, Junlong Cheng, Jianpin Chen, Junjun He, Shaoting Zhang, Lixu Gu, Yu Qiao
arxiv-2309-03906.description: Abstract Although deep learning have revolutionized abdominal multi-organ segmentation, models often struggle with generalization due to training on small, specific datasets. With the recent emergence of large-scale datasets, some important questions arise: Can models trained on these datasets generalize well on different ones? If yes/no, how to further improve their generalizability?

arxiv-2409-16518.title: Disoriented isospin condensates in heavy-ion collisions
arxiv-2409-16518.creator: \firstname Joseph \lastname Kapusta \fnsep, \firstname Scott \lastname Pratt \fnsep, \firstname Mayank \lastname Singh \fnsep
arxiv-2409-16518.description: Abstract Anomalous neutral to charged kaon correlations measured by the ALICE collaboration have defied usual explanations. We propose that the large fluctuations could arise because of a disoriented isospin condensate where there is an imbalance between up and down condensates at the time kaons hadronize.

arxiv-2504-03000.title: Fuzzy Implicative Rules: A Unified Approach
arxiv-2504-03000.creator: Raquel Fernandez-Peralta
arxiv-2504-03000.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Raquel Fernandez-Peralta. Rule mining algorithms are one of the fundamental techniques in data mining for disclosing significant patterns in terms of linguistic rules expressed in natural language. In this paper, we revisit the concept of fuzzy implicative rule to provide a solid theoretical framework for any fuzzy rule mining algorithm interested in capturing patterns in terms of logical conditionals rather than the co-occurrence of antecedent and consequent.

pmc-10672689.title: Differences in Androgen Receptor Expression in Human Heart Tissue in Various Types of Cardiomyopathy and in Aortic Valve Stenosis
pmc-10672689.creator: Katja Eildermann, Sabrina Goldmann, Ulrich Krause, David Backhoff, Friedrich A. Schöndube, Thomas Paul, Thomas Quentin, Matthias J. Müller
pmc-10672689.description: Background: Sex-specific differences in heart disease outcomes are influenced by the levels of the steroid hormones, estrogen and testosterone. While the roles of estrogen receptors in cardiac disease are well-studied in animals and humans, respective research on androgen receptors (AR) is limited. Here we investigate AR protein and mRNA expression in human myocardium of various cardiac diseases.

pmc-11298086.title: The role of diet in cancer: the potential of shaping public policy and clinical outcomes in the UK
pmc-11298086.creator: Oliver Britten, Sabrina Tosi
pmc-11298086.description: Cancer universally represents one of the largest public health concerns, substantially contributing to global disease burden and mortality. The multifaceted interplay of environmental and genetic factors in the disease aetiology and progression has required comprehensive research to elucidate modifiable elements which can reduce the risk of incidence and improve prognosis.

pmc-11504994.title: Development of an Oral Epithelial Ex Vivo Organ Culture Model for Biocompatibility and Permeability Assessment of Biomaterials
pmc-11504994.creator: Foteini Machla, Chrysanthi Bekiari, Paraskevi Kyriaki Monou, Evangelia Kofidou, Astero Maria Theodosaki, Orestis L. Katsamenis, Vasileios Zisis, Maria Kokoti, Athina Bakopoulou, Dimitrios Fatouros, Dimitrios Andreadis
pmc-11504994.description: In the present study, a customized device (Epi-ExPer) was designed and fabricated to facilitate an epithelial organ culture, allowing for controlled exposure to exogenous chemical stimuli and accommodating the evaluation of permeation of the tissue after treatment. The Epi-ExPer system was fabricated using a stereolithography (SLA)-based additive manufacturing (AM) method.

pmc-12366209.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis on the global prevalence of helminthic parasites among schoolchildren: a public health concern
pmc-12366209.creator: Milad Badri, Meysam Olfatifar, Zahra Gharibi, Mahendra Pal, Kareem Hatam-Nahavandi, Ali Asghari, Giovanni Sgroi, Hanieh Soltani, Amir Abdoli, Aida Vafae Eslahi
pmc-12366209.description: BackgroundNeglected tropical diseases (NTDs) are responsible for substantial illness and death worldwide. Helminthic infections among school-aged children pose a serious public health challenge due to their detrimental effects on health and development.MethodsA wide-ranging search conducted across five databases, including Scopus, EMBASE, PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar to retrieve papers published between 1998 and 2024.

pmc-12561509.title: Macrophages in Autoimmune Liver Diseases: From Immune Homeostasis to Precision-Targeted Therapy
pmc-12561509.creator: Tianfu Liu, Yizhe Wang, Yichen Huang, Rui Zhao, Haili Shen, Wolfgang Kreisel
pmc-12561509.description: Autoimmune liver diseases (AILDs) represent a diverse spectrum of chronic inflammatory conditions characterized primarily by compromised hepatic immune tolerance, including autoimmune hepatitis (AIH), primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), and primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC). Recent evidence positions macrophages as pivotal players in AILDs pathogenesis, attributable to their multifaceted roles in inflammation amplification, immune regulation, and fibrogenesis.

pmc-12831442.title: Efficacy and safety of tranexamic acid during bariatric surgery: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 comparative studies
pmc-12831442.creator: Ahmed Abu-Zaid, Monirah Khaled Alotaibi, Fajer N. Hasan, Hadeel A. Alkandari, Sara Almutawtah, Bader N. Almutawaa, Mohammad Salem Alajmi, Fahad N. Aladwani, Lulwah A Alselahy, Fatemah A. Ali, Sarah Saqer Alblooshi, Hessa Mohammed Alfayadh, Abdullah M. Alharran
pmc-12831442.description: AimThis study aimed to conduct an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of comparative studies evaluating the efficacy and safety of tranexamic acid (TXA) during bariatric surgery.MethodsSix databases were searched up to September 2, 2025. The primary endpoint was the rate of postoperative bleeding. Secondary endpoints included transfusion, hematoma, reoperation, thromboembolic events, operative time, and hospital stay.
